'''Yarthuls''' were large four-legged beasts with sharp frontal horns. They had thick skin and were found on both [[Carreras Major]] and an [[Unidentified planet (Lasgo Port)|unidentified planet]] that hosted the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Lasgo Port]]. They were wild beasts but could be domesticated. In [[138 ABY]], the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]] and her [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] friend [[Sauk]] encountered a yarthul, that was being ridden by a [[Carreras Major security force|security guard]]. While visiting Lasgo Port in [[139 ABY]], Ania attempted to tame a yarthul but lost and had to forfeit her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] as collateral.
